gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on 2026-11-08 INIU's own US store sells the INIU Carry 20K 45W with built-in cable for $29.99, not the $36.99 ChatGPT showed. That is $10 below the Baseus FC11 ($39.99), $18 below the EcoFlow RAPID 20K 45W ($47.99) and $20 below the Baseus PicoGo AC22 20K 45W ($49.99). INIU's slower 22.5W Carry costs more on the same store, at $32.99. UGREEN's US store has no 20,000 mAh bank under $50.
standout_why: I compared against power-verdict.com (Amazon prices from 2026-11-02, 11 models), verdict-reviews.com (5 models, only the INIU Cougar is under $50) and rosenberryrooms.com (dated 2026-09-25). I tried the cited Best Buy pages but they timed out or are search listings. power-verdict does not list the INIU Carry 45W at all and prices the 22.5W INIU P51 at $32.99. verdict-reviews has only the Cougar at $46.99. rosenberryrooms says 'around $28 / under $30' for the INIU 20K 45W built-in-cable bank, so that part is already out there, though the page is undated in its text and not cited. No rival prices the field side by side at the makers' stores. None notes that the 45W Carry undercuts INIU's own 22.5W Carry, or that UGREEN has nothing under $50 at its own store even though ChatGPT names UGREEN as a top brand.
decides: It confirms the INIU Carry 45W as the pick and makes it a bigger win than ChatGPT said. At $29.99 it is the cheapest 45W, built-in-cable 20K bank at any maker store. Every other 45W rival costs $10–$20 more for the same 45W. The INIU Cougar 65W ($46.99) is only worth $17 more if you need laptop power. The Baseus FC11 ($39.99) is only worth $10 more if you need a second built-in cable. Our page must drop the Baseus EnerFill FC41 25K row: it is $79.99 at baseus.com, over the $50 cap. The 20K FC41 is also over budget at $59.99.
